verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own Data Access API, published as an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec with pagination and authentication docs, for retrieving "errors, projects, organization and more." This gives users a first-party, programmatic way to pull their data out, and the webhook data-forwarding plugin streams error and project data as it arrives. However, nothing in the evidence describes a bulk or complete export, names the export format, or covers offboarding; leaving would mean scripting extraction against a rate-limited API. Missing for 10: a documented one-step or bulk export of all account data, an explicit open-format guarantee (e.g. JSON/CSV dumps), coverage of all data types such as performance/spans and sessions, offboarding guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful full export.
